items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he got Nat to come out, Nat and the trio plus myself to record some things... later on when I went with Nat... Hampton just left Goodman, so when he come out -- he really wanted Nat, but I had been to New York... what he wanted for the rhythm section was Nat's trio and myself

ctx.x: Do you remember what year and where? Do you remember how old you were?
No, see, that's the difficult thing about me. Now I can tell you about situations and incidents, you know, but I don't have a clue to the year then, and if you

bring it on up in to the years, most anything I'm telling you about, I will not be able to tell you the year, you know? I have never been in to that, and I've never been able to do that -- but I can tell you the situations and what happened.
